chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskhan, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
"Pray them (the two Fajr prayers) with the dawn prayer, and before it and after it."

key_terms.هُمَا: The two (referring to the two voluntary prayers)

ai.seo_question: When should the two voluntary Fajr prayers be performed in relation to the obligatory Fajr prayer?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the flexibility of the two sunnah rak'ahs of Fajr is highlighted, allowing them to be performed before, after, or integrated with the obligatory Fajr prayer. This reflects the Shia scholarly view on the permissibility of combining these voluntary units with the fard prayer, offering believers ease in worship while maintaining the spiritual discipline of dawn prayers. The hadith underscores the importance of consistency in devotional practices, a theme frequently emphasized in Shia fiqh regarding the preservation of sunnah acts alongside obligatory duties.
